title: Airtable Review (2026)
intro: Airtable is evaluated here as a flexible database / app builder with light project tracking — Airtable is a spreadsheet-database hybrid for building lightweight apps, interfaces and project trackers. Free limited; Team ~$20/user/mo annual; Business ~$45; Enterprise Scale custom. Strong when structured data + interfaces matter — heavier TCO than Notion for simple docs. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Airtable when you need a flexible database/app layer for operational trackers — landscape beside Work OS and Notion.
verdict: Choose Airtable when you need a flexible database/app layer for operational trackers — landscape beside Work OS and Notion. Compare Notion for docs-first, Smartsheet for PMO grids, and Asana/monday for dedicated Work OS execution. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Familiar sheet UX with database power — learning curve rises with Interfaces/automations.
Can model projects well, but not a dedicated Work OS planning product.
Automations are capable; still a builder tool more than a PM suite.
Shared bases and Interfaces support team workflows well.
Sync and connector ecosystem is a strength for ops stacks.
Interfaces and views support operational reporting mid-pack.
Scales into Business/Enterprise for larger data apps.
Team ~$20 and Business ~$45 are premium vs Notion/Asana for light PM. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI features present; not the primary wedge vs Motion/Notion AI for many buyers.

pricingSummary: Free; Team ~$20, Business ~$45 annual; Enterprise custom. Confirm live.

faq.question: Is Airtable a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. Airtable is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is Airtable priced?
faq.answer: Free; Team ~$20, Business ~$45 annual; Enterprise custom. Confirm live.

faq.question: Does Airtable have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. A free trial is documented. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Airtable?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
